import { Component, EventEmitter, Output } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { RouterModule, Router } from '@angular/router'; import { AuthService } from '../../services/auth.service'; import { TaskService } from '../../services/task.service'; /** * Corporate Minimalist Navigation Header Component. * Restricts Task Creation to Team Leads and Project Managers, features Ping Notification Alerts, and user profile links. */ @Component({ selector: 'app-header', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, RouterModule], template: `
Priority Alert: Lead pinged {{ taskService.developerNotifications().length }} task(s) assigned to you: #{{ t.id }} - {{ t.title }}
P

Priora

Enterprise Task Priority Engine
Canvas Settings Approvals Users
{{ authService.currentUser()?.fullName?.charAt(0) || 'U' }}
{{ authService.currentUser()?.fullName }}
{{ getRoleLabel(authService.currentUser()?.role) }}
` }) export class HeaderComponent { @Output() openCreateModal = new EventEmitter(); constructor( public authService: AuthService, public taskService: TaskService, private router: Router ) {} getRoleLabel(role?: string): string { switch (role) { case 'ROLE_PROJECT_MANAGER': return 'Project Manager'; case 'ROLE_TEAM_LEAD': return 'Team Lead'; case 'ROLE_TESTER': return 'Tester'; case 'ROLE_TEAM_MEMBER': return 'Developer'; default: return role ? role.replace('ROLE_', '') : 'Developer'; } } onSignOut(): void { this.authService.logout(); this.router.navigate(['/login']); } }
